scope: Actual retail VM 482380 runs push/store integer and float instructions 42..45 and subsequent integer/float global reads. Covers four manager integers -9926..-9923, eight manager floats -9922..-9915, four Boss integer and four Boss float destinations with Boss present/absent, and writable absolute/relative XY positions -9995..-9992. Native 42b0b0/42bcc0 writable-reference dispatch and 42a920/42b230 read dispatch execute without stubs; all 39 watched storage words and typed read results agree across 352 cases, including large signed integers, NaN/infinity and signed zero. Boss-missing writes fall back to owner storage while reads return zero. No claim about remaining globals, callbacks, complete gameplay or position recombination after writes. Also executes both integer/float read paths for -9906 and -9986 across every flags bit plus combined masks: mirror bit 19 and phase-timeout bit 24. 4112 full native VM reads cover -10000/-9999/-9998/-9987 over 514 deterministic seeds, comparing typed values and final seed/call count. Both -10000 paths mask the high bit before integer/float conversion; integer -9998 returns zero without consuming RNG. Other globals remain outside this proof.
